newsitem.title: BRAZIL: More wintry weather to return to Brazil CS sugar.
newsitem.headline: More wintry weather to return to Brazil CS sugar.

text.p: More normal wintry weather is set to return to Brazil's center-south sugar growing region this week, independent consultants DataNet-AgriCommodities said in a regular weather update.
A cold front should lead to a drop in temperatures throughout the week in the key producing regions and cloudy weather with scattered showers in isolated areas.
The conditions will favor the development of sugar cane, leading to higher sugar content.
Light rains should not present any serious delays in loadings at Santos and Paranagua ports, DataNet said.
In the north/northeast growing region of Brazil, a high pressure system should mean cloudy weather with light to moderate showers, mainly at night, it added.
